remarks: Welcome to your new urban oasis in the heart of Stamford! This 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath condo offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, nestled in a quiet neighborhood just a stone's throw from the vibrant Bedford Street area. Step into the kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a charming breakfast bar, gleaming hardwood floors and crown molding throughout. Forget cramped closets - the primary bedroom boasts a large walk-in closet, while the secondary bedroom features not one, but two closets! Speaking of closets, there are two additional large closets to store more of your personal items located in the lower level that will absolutely WOW you. Yearning for some fresh air? Say hello to two private balconies, your ideal spot to savor your morning coffee or unwind after a long day. Central air and an attached garage complete the full package. Come check out your next place to call home within walking distance to the hottest restaurants, shops, theaters, train station and more!
